scope: Descriptive reference for each q=1,2,3 and d=2..11; not a pooled confidence estimate.

exclusions.reason: Eq.24 is an alternative analysis from the same paper. Use the conventional equal-height estimate in Eq.14 once; retain Eq.24 as a substitution sensitivity, not an additional independent input.
The source explicitly states that accessible bond dimensions are not yet in the convergent regime.

limitations: Quoted errors are nominal weighting scales: Monte Carlo uncertainties, series spread and HOTRG convergence diagnostics are not necessarily comparable standard deviations.
W2014 q=2,d=3 remains included. Its small quoted error dominates this mean; the leave-W2014-out diagnostic gives the Monte Carlo-only alternative.
Sources can share authors, methods or data. Distinct source IDs are not a claim of statistical independence.
No pooled uncertainty, confidence interval, or physical accuracy guarantee is inferred.
Published series used by an estimator and a literature reference can overlap; their comparison is not independent validation.
